title: Toddler Holding Easter Basket Indoors, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet black-and-white home snapshot showing a blonde toddler sitting on a chair, gazing with wonder into a woven Easter basket lined with shiny cellophane grass. The young child clutches a plush white Easter bunny while examining the contents of the basket. In the background, the wooden railings of a crib or gate are visible in a softly lit domestic interior, capturing a tender postwar mid-century family holiday tradition.
